reader.requirement: At 1985, FUNCTION ANNUITY (argument-1 argument-2) with argument-1 nonzero (and >= 0 by AR2) must return an approximation of argument-1 / (1 - (1 + argument-1) ** (-argument-2)), argument-2 a positive integer in any written form.

edition-consulted.switches: the D8 edition window: sig.IntroducedIn (85 for the 1989 Intrinsic Function module rows) against ctx.Edition.DialectLevel; COBOL1502/1503 outside it

construct numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002: at 85 a numeric function written where an identifier stands (DISPLAY/MOVE operand) is refused (COBOL0900), per 1985 IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4; 2002+ accepts it. Not consulted inside COMPUTE

DialectBehavior.UnphrasedSizeErrorIsFatal: at 85 a COMPUTE with no SIZE ERROR phrase catches every size condition and continues (1985 VI.6.4.2 GR3); 2002+ takes the fatal-EC shape. Statement-level, around the function value, not inside it
num.StandardDecimal (arithmetic mode): the ARITHMETIC clause does not exist at 85, so 85 always takes the native arms, the same arms the latest edition takes by default

reader.edition-search: grep of IntrinsicRenderer.cs and the runtime CobolIntrinsics.*.cs for Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior: the renderer's function dispatch and every runtime body consult no edition (the runtime Intrinsics folder has none); the generated C# at --std 85 and --std 2023 differs only in the assembly Edition attribute and the COMPUTE size-error wrapper (diff of var85-002/var85.g.cs vs var85-003, trig85-001 vs trig85-002)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers one tiny rate (1E-17, 12 periods); ordinary rates, a rate of 1, one period, a huge period count and an integer expression for argument-2 are not exercised

probes.printed: ANNUITY(0.1 2.5) COBOL1627; ANNUITY(-0.1 3) prints 0 and the program continues
probes.expected: refused (AR3); a negative rate violates AR2, so the result is undefined (A.1.2.2)

citations.check: OK  §1989:A.2.6.4 RV2  (cite.py --check with quoted words: "When the value of argument-1 is not zero")
OK  §1989:A.1.2.2  (cite.py --check with quoted words: "then the result of such a reference is undefined")

reader.notes: The body evaluates rate / -expm1(-n * log1p(rate)), algebraically the RV2 expression, with Kahan's expm1/log1p twins so small rates keep relative precision; results match an independent mpmath oracle to the 14 printed places.

refuter.evidence: ann12-001: ANNUITY(0.1 3.0)=.4021148036 (literal 3.0 admitted as integer per A.2.2 AR4; 0.4021148036253776 exact); annint-001: ANNUITY(.1 FUNCTION INTEGER(3.5))=.4021148036; ANNUITY(1 1)=2; ANNUITY(1000 1)=1001; ANNUITY(.5 N * 2) N=3 = .5481203007 (.5/(1-1.5**-6)=0.548120300751...). annmean-001: numeric function as argument-2 refused (COBOL1627). cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.6.4 RV2 ('When the value of argument-1 is not zero'); OK §1989:A.2.6.3 AR3 ('Argument-2 must be a positive integer').
